scope: rank3 float64 analytic feature rows and full-bank transport
packed rowwise GN and scalar variance
fixed-anchor updates and original prior ownership
refresh failure recovery, quarantine and checkpoint replay

findings.problem: Python ctypes inputs were neither cast to float64 nor shape checked, allowing short or differently typed buffers to violate fixed native extents.
findings.witness: initialize accepted np.zeros(32,dtype=np.float32), a wrong coordinate shape with sufficient backing bytes to avoid an unsafe witness.
findings.repair: Finite exact16 coordinate validation, float64 conversion, Nx34 row validation and copied dimension-checked prior. Targeted malformed inputs pass.

findings.problem: scalar() returned the anchor/current workspace point unless query() had already called estimate(), so the scalar-only readout was stale.
findings.repair: scalar() syncs live model arrays and estimates before scalar transport; scalar-first parity test passes.

validation.test_count_note: Includes four imported bank-memory fixture tests, four rowwise core tests and four campaign tests.

offcentre_independent_probe.construction: SOC uniform0.1..0.9; branch voltages uniform-0.02..0.02; eta uniform-4..4; ordered tau from fixed centres times exp(uniform-0.9..0.9); H log-rate offsets uniform-0.9..0.9; other coordinates at prior mean. Compare feature rows/J and direct C transport with existing SmallField reference.

validation.algebra_inspection: QR stacks original whitened prior [I,w] once with history feature residual/J rows. GN decrement is squared transformed residual excluding the orthogonal residual; derivative scaling and triangular covariance solve have correct orientation. Endpoint RC transport uses full13 poles, preserving free/forced response state.

memory_review.finding: Core contains no heap, dense W-by-W factor copy, W-by16 cached Jacobian, normal matrix or full covariance. Host adapter explicitly allocates covariance-root output and inherits dense construction/checkpoint work.
memory_review.target_note: Parent measures crosscompiled M23 layout and stack independently; no complete-device SRAM or WCET acceptance in this review.

limits: Conditional on serial execution, valid fixed-size C arrays and immutable calibration/projection tables; native API is not a hostile-memory boundary.
Finite tests and local solver agreement do not validate coverage, physical projection error, lifetime rounding, aging or temperature behavior.
The host campaign still owns response generation, observation staging, dense covariance plotting carrier and checkpoints.
Rebuilding at old anchor after a rejected refresh preserves represented evidence, but is not guaranteed bitwise equal to the earlier incrementally accumulated tangent.
No long sweep or firmware deployment qualification performed.
